_about.purpose: The welcome screen is the only screen in English. It is shown once, on first launch.
_about.howToEdit: Change any value on the right-hand side; keep the keys and any {placeholders} as they are.
_about.rest: Every other string in the app is French and lives in strings_fr.json.

welcome.title: BAH Français
welcome.intro: Learn and keep your French in the odd spare minute.
welcome.pointSessions: Sessions are as short as you like. Start, answer a few cards, stop whenever — nothing is lost.
welcome.pointSpacedRepetition: Words and verbs come back just before you would forget them.
welcome.pointNoPressure: No streaks, no badges, no notifications, no accounts.
welcome.pointPrivacy: Everything stays on this phone and is included in its backups. Deleting the app deletes your progress.
welcome.pointKnownWords: Already know a word? Tap “Je le connais” during a drill and it won't come back.
welcome.pointFrench: From here on, the app is in French.
welcome.crashReportsBody: Anonymous crash reports only — no personal data and no usage tracking. You can change this any time in Réglages.
